Talent trees are/were the implementation of talents that existed prior to patch 5.0.4 and that exist after patch 10.0.0. Active and passive talents were arranged in three separate 'trees', with access to progressively "higher" or "deeper" tiers of talents granted by spending sufficient talent points in that tree. Talent trees were the predecessors to class specializations, predating the introduction of actual specializations by many years, with a player's choice of talents often determining which combat role they were fit to perform. Talent trees acted to limit access to talents by the character's level; by where they had chosen to place their previous talent points; and later by specializat

.]] The Tainted Scar is a small region in the western Blasted Lands, corrupted for years by the energies of the Dark Portal. Following the Third War, it became the demonic domain of Lord Kazzak and his army until the Invasion of Outland. At the time of the Cataclysm, the Tainted Scar has been greatly transformed by the birth of the Tainted Forest.
Tainted Vial is the deprecated version of Crystal Vial (Classic) (no relation to the new Crystal Vial). Any Crystal Vials that players owned at the time of patch 4.0.3a were turned into this.

__NOTOC__ Taladan is a night elf artisan enchanting trainer located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. He is seen conversing with the Highborne magi Aladrel Whitespire. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

__NOTOC__ Talen is a night elf quest giver located at the Blackfathom Camp just off the Zoram Strand northeast of the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. He is an amateur archaeologist and is searching for ancient artifacts in Zoram Strand.
Takrin Pathseeker is an orc quest giver located in Razor Hill in Durotar. He's a scout.
Tainted Vitriol is acquired while mining veins in Felwood while in possession of a Cenarion Beacon. It is an objective of the quest Salve via Mining

__NOTOC__ Taldan was a night elf drink vendor located in Auberdine in Darkshore. Taldan died during the destruction of Auberdine in the Cataclysm, and his body can be found inside the ruins of the building where he used to stand.

Takar the Seer is a human located at Forward Command in the Southern Barrens. He could originally be found at a small camp east of Camp Taurajo in what was then the Horde-aligned territory of the Barrens. He was friendly to Alliance and hostile (but not aggressive) to Horde despite the lack of an Alliance presence in the area. In the wake of the Cataclysm, Takar moved to the Alliance camp Forward Command in the Fields of Blood. Whether he survived the Horde conquest is unclear.

Takk the Leaper is a named elite rare mob raptor found roaming the ridge southeast of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens. The raptor is on a 4-6 hour respawn timer and was once popular for its supersonic chase speed. Takk's speed was eventually reduced, however, a new incentive for players to hunt for Takk was given in the form of a unique companion.
__NOTOC__ Talasite is a rare quality gem used in Jewelcrafting and Engineering, the gems fit both and sockets.

talbuk as seen in a piece of Hearthstone artwork.]] Talbuks are beautifully colored, striped, horned antelope-like creatures native to Argus. Some talbuks fled Argus with the draenei aboard the Genedar. On Draenor (later Outland), a world the Genedar crashed on, the alien species thrived, becoming a viable food source for the native predators and a part of orcish culture. Talbuks live primarily in the plains of Nagrand but could also be found in before its corruption. They usually congregate underneath trees, but some groups of them are seen wandering with their respective patriarchs. The talbuks are diurnal creatures. During winter nights, they dig hollows in the snow in which to curl up to
Talendria is a night elf quest giver located at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Tainted Pierce is a one-hand sword that is most often sought after by Rogues.

Tainted Keg is a quest item for Elixir of Agony (5). It is made by poisoning a Keg of Shindigger Stout stolen from the dwarves of Dun Garok with a concoction created by Apothecary Lydon. Put on a Dusty Rug, it is drunk by Captured Farmers who die.
__NOTOC__ Tainted Arcane Wraiths are arcane wraiths found at Falthrien Academy of Eversong Woods. They serve under Felendren the Banished.
__NOTOC__ Talaara is a draenei weapon vendor located at the Temple of Telhamat in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Tales of the Past is a World of Warcraft storyline trilogy, based upon the realm of Dunemaul (EU) using machinima. Martin Falch (Maquan) is the director of the trilogy. Of all WoW fanfiction, Tales of the Past has arguably the most complex storyline and the greatest tie-in to lore. It is also possibly the largest scale machinima movie ever created using recordings from World of Warcraft - with multiple large battle-scenes involving thousands of players participating. It is worth noting that - whist Arthas and Northrend are all present in the trilogy - the movies were filmed before the release of Wrath of the Lich King. The Tainted Heart is provided as an objective for Planting the Heart.

Tal'kraa was once the Elder Shaman of the Frostwolf Clan. He passed away nearly a century prior to the creation of the Dark Portal. Mother Kashur was his great granddaughter. Though he was many generations removed from her, and she had never met him, she called him simply grandfather. When Draka asked Kashur to help her healing her illness, Kashur spoke to Tal'kraa through a vision and he obviously told her how to help Draka. Later, he visited Mother Kashur in her dreams and demanded she take the then-young Durotan to Oshu'gun so he could see him with his own "eyes". He sensed Durotan would never be a shaman, but knew he had a great destiny and from his line salvation would come.
Talario is a human spellcaster. She is the sister of Renmar. She is a companion to Drann.
Though they are free from the Lich King's dominance, the death knights' battle has just begun...
Taking on All Challengers is part of The Sons of Hodir quest chain.
__NOTOC__ Talandra's Rose is a herb that can be gathered with Herbalism (385).

Tailyda is a Blizzard employee and an English language In-Game Customer Support Representative and Game Master for the European World of Warcraft community. He is normally encountered on the EU forums, specifically the [http://eu.battle.net/wow/en/forum/975485/ English Customer Support forums]. He is based in the newer EU offices in Ireland.
Cellian Daybreak offers this quest to both Alliance and Horde characters, other than Death Knights. Zor'be the Bloodletter offers this quest to Alliance and Horde Death Knights.

Tala Snowgraze is a tauren, leading the "Circle of Defiance", rally Cenarion Expedition members to protest against the Ango'rosh tribe who are cutting the mushrooms of Zangarmarsh and are damaging the ecology and economy. During one of their protests the ogres attacked them and killed a jungle troll, everyone flee for their lives and another troll stopped to cry for the dead of his companion. Later she was interviewed by Spoggle Greasecakes where she told him that the naga are draining the waters of Zangarmarsh for an unknown purpose, while behind her is a battle between the Cenarion Expedition and Illidan's Naga. At the end of the interview she told that they had to stop the naga.
Take a Chill Pill is a player vs. player achievement earned for killing a player who is under the effects of the berserker buff.

Tainted Quel'Delar is provided by Halduron Brightwing as an objective for The Purification of Quel'Delar. After standing in the Sunwell and using the item, Quel'Delar is restored into Restored Quel'Delar.
Takk's Nest is a raptor nest belonging to Takk the Leaper, found in the northeastern Northern Barrens. Leaping Hatchling can be found here.

Tales of Azeroth is a weekly fan webcomic project by Ikatsu Hayashi started in March 14th, 2010 and features the adventures of many champions of Azeroth. The stories are meant to follow the lore, including quests, books and games, from the point of view of the alliance. As opposite of most WoW related comics, ToA is not humorous but still entertaining.
Takrik Ragehowl is an orc located at the Shrine of Goldrinn in Mount Hyjal.
__NOTOC__ Talaa is a draenei shaman located in Highbank in the Twilight Highlands. She aids in the creation and maintenance of a portal to Stormwind.

Tainted Blood of the Kaldorei is provided by Durak to use on Forest Heart in the Dor'Danil Barrow Den for Pierce Their Heart!. It is the blood of night elf attackers on Splintertree Post, extracted by Durak from Kadrak's axe.

Tal'doren Trackers are worgen found during the Worgen starting experience. They will spawn only if the worgen player uses the Horn of Tal'doren during the quest Take Back What's Ours, after which they will ambush the Veteran Dark Rangers standing at Wood's End Cabin. This is made in order to give the player time to retrieve the Mysterious Artifact, which is in fact the Scythe of Elune. After 30 seconds, the Tal'doren Trackers will warstomp, stunning the Dark Rangers for a few more seconds, and retreat back into the woods.

Tak'arili is a jungle troll quest giver located deep inside the Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands. Adventurers are sent to speak with him by Rofilian Dane. It is unknown what became of him when the Iron Horde took over the mines, but he may have been killed during the process or escaped.
Tainted Sentrys are water elementals found in the Throne of the Tides.
Tainted Elemental spawns from the water at the foot of the stairs during Lady Vashj encounter. Every 50 seconds, one Tainted Elemental spawns instead of an Enchanted Elemental.
Tak Tak is the High Leader Chief of the Broketooth hozen in Kun-Lai Summit.
__NOTOC__ Tainted Nightstalkers are bone spiders found in the Tainted Forest in the Blasted Lands.
__NOTOC__ Tainted Black Bears are black plagued bears found in Blasted Lands.
Talak is a Zandalari troll who wanted a direhorn. He went to the Isle of Giants but died there.

__NOTOC__ Talador Orchid is looted from Talador Orchid nodes located in Talador and nodes located in the garrison Herb Garden. A Disturbed Podling may randomly spawn when gathering a node, which drops the herb the player gathered when killed.
The Talador storyline is the level-up experience in Talador in southern . The progress of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Don't Let the Tala-door Hit You on the Way Out.
Taladite Crystal is a rare crafting reagent used for many of the Warlords of Draenor Jewelcrafting recipes.

Talakuu was a draenei located in the cave at Lunarfall in . Judging by the circumstances, he was killed by Quakefist. From his equipment, where he died and the text from Quakefist (quest), he was probably a peacekeeper from Karabor.
__NOTOC__ Tak'moa is a jungle troll Holy priest. His Alliance counterpart is Alasdair Whitepeak.

Tale-Teller's Staff is a potential reward from the following Class Hall missions: *A Fel Journey *Mind Your Step *Great Steaks *Shoot to Thrill *Traitors Below *Critical Crops (mission) It is also a quest reward from poor elite world quests in the Broken Isles, and be found inside Kirin Tor Chest and Curious Wyrmtongue Cache.
Tako Whisperpaw is a pandaren who can be found in the Hall of Shadows. He later traveled to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.

Talan is the goblin owner of the namesake "Talan's Bar" in Gadgetzan in the Mean Streets of Gadgetzan expansion for Hearthstone. Prior to the expansion's release, several promotional images were released in the form of pages from a Gadgetzan newspaper called The Gadgetzan Gazette, page one of which featured an advert for Talan's Bar and a [http://blizz.ly/talansbar special URL] that allowed readers to exchange messages with Talan himself to learn more about the backstory of the upcoming expansion.

is challenged to Tal'ashar by Coryn Stelleris.]] Tal'ashar is an ancient rite within the nightborne civilization, the invocation of which leads to an honor duel between the accused and accuser (or representatives of one or the other). The duel is to the death.
__NOTOC__ Take Them Out is an achievement earned by killing faction specific targets within the Road of Glory.

The Tainted Burrow is a large, shallow pool in Darkheart Thicket. This where the third boss of the dungeon resides, Dresaron. This drake's corrupted eggs line the slough and hatch when touched. One needs to be careful while traversing this area. The Tainted Burrow is one of two choices where you can go after defeating Oakheart in the Miasmic Gorge. After you defeat Dresaron, a small cliff face takes you down and into the Heart of Dread.
Talar Icechill is a lich located at the Ruby Dragonshrine in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.
Take Command is a quest achievement earned from contributing a combined total of 500 Legionfall War Supplies to the Command Center on the Broken Shore.
The Tailthrasher tribe is a group of saberon based in Tailthrasher Basin in Gorgrond.

Talanji is the Queen of the Zandalari Empire and daughter of God King Rastakhan. She is a priestess of the loa Rezan. She later forms Talanji's Expedition, a united group of Zandalari and Darkspear Trolls who combat the blood trolls of Nazmir. Unlike her father, Talanji does not think the old ways are always best and believes that the Zandalari must adapt if they are to survive in a changing world. While her father's advisers were wary of making an alliance with the Horde, Talanji was a staunch supporter of the Zandalari and Horde uniting to face their common enemies. Following her father's death during the Battle of Dazar'alor, Talanji succeeds him as Queen of Zandalar. Following the end of

Tal'farrak is the Farraki enclave in Zuldazar. It can be found in the north-western wing of the Port of Zandalar. There is a shrine dedicated to Mueh'zala.

Talanji's Expedition is an expedition of Zandalari trolls from Zuldazar, backed by the Darkspear tribe. It is personally led by Talanji, Princess of the Zandalari Empire. The expedition will face off against the blood troll forces.

Tainted Runescale Koi can be fished from Suramar in open water or Runescale Koi Schools while under the effect of the Demonic Detritus. After obtaining the Underlight Angler, using the Detritus will instead lure Tainted Runescale Koi.

Tainted Screechers are vampire bats located in the Blasted Lands.
The Talanji's Expedition Commendation is automatically consumed and provides the amount of reputation shown in its tooltip with Talanji's Expedition.

Tales of de Loa: Kimbul is a scroll located on the cliffs near the Territorial Hydra on the Cracked Coast in Vol'dun. It contains a tale of the loa Eraka no Kimbul. After having been interacted with, it can be found in the Hall of Chroniclers in Dazar'alor.

Tales of de Loa: Akunda is a tablet lying in the central pool of Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun. It contains a tale of the loa Akunda. After having been interacted with, it can be found in the Hall of Chroniclers in Dazar'alor.

Tales of de Loa: Rezan is located in Xibala in Zuldazar. It contains a story about the loa Rezan. After having been interacted with, it can be found in the Hall of Chroniclers in Dazar'alor.

Tales of de Loa: Shadra is located in the Shrine of Shadra in Zuldazar. It contains a story about the loa Shadra. After having been interacted with, it can be found in the Hall of Chroniclers in Dazar'alor.
Tales of de Loa: Torga is located at Torga's Tavern in Nazmir. It contains a story about the loa Torga. After having been interacted with, it can be found in the Hall of Chroniclers in Dazar'alor.
The Talador Sentinel Gauntlets is a quest reward from Aruumel's Rest.
Tainted Blood Vambraces drop from Blood Priest Xak'lar in Nazmir.
Tainted Lightwings are moths located at Deadwalker Pass and Umbrafen Point in .
Takata is a tortollan located at Scaletrader Post in Zuldazar.
Talanji's Mojo is provided as an objective for Don't Stalk Me, Troll (Horde).
The Tainted Crystal drops from Frenzyheart Ravagers and Frenzyheart Hunters in Sholazar Basin. It is used to summon Soo-holu.
Tainted Guardian is a Zandalari golem located in Nazmir. It is being activated by Sethrak Skycallers.
Talaren Silvertongue is night elf ghost located at the Drowned Market in Nazjatar.
Taintheart Tormenters are satyrs located in the Clutch of Corruption in the Emerald Nightmare.
Taintheart Tricksters are satyrs located in the Clutch of Corruption in the Emerald Nightmare.
Tainted Plainstriders are tallstriders located in Mulgore in the Emerald Nightmare.
Taintheart Deadeyes are satyrs located in Darkheart Thicket.
Taintheart Stalkers are satyrs located in Darkheart Thicket.
Tainted Tentacles are tentacles summoned by the Mother of Wolves in the Frost Den in Frostfire Ridge.
Tainted Earthgrab Totems are totems summoned by Ortor of Murkblood in Nagrand and Mennu the Betrayer in the Slave Pens.

Tainted Ales are barrels with fel-corrupted brew located at Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

Tal-Inara is the Honored Voice, the attendant responsible for speaking on behalf of the Arbiter in Oribos. She was originally chosen to serve as the voice of second Arbiter, who was eternally silent and never spoke a single word herself. Following Pelagos becoming the new Arbiter, Tal-Inara continues to serve as his Honored Voice.
Taint Nobody Got Time For That is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating Elder Leaxa without any party member receiving the Taint of G'huun in Underrot.
Tal'gurub Berserkers are dead jungle dire trolls located in Tal'gurub in Zuldazar. They were slain by the Jambani, while survivors were taken as mindslaves.
Taking the Seat begins the Necrolords Campaign. Players must have chosen the Necrolords Covenant to start this quest.
Tainted Centurion Components can be melted down into Purified Metal at the Eternal Forge.
Tainted Void-Touched Cores drop rarely from Ti'or in the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus.
Taldaram's Supple Slippers drop from Prince Taldaram at the Fleshwerks in Icecrown during Death Rising.
The ID of Tainted Anima Mass was repurposed by Coded Notes during development.
Tal'gurub Loa Priests are dead jungle trolls located in Tal'gurub in Zuldazar. They were slain by the Jambani.
Take the Bite Out of 'Em is a potential Venthyr Covenant-daily quest accessible once Sinfall's Anima Conductor with Tier 2 is channeled into Pridefall Hamlet.

Taiya Tacere is a skeleton located in the armory in the southeastern part of the Seat of the Primus, where she redeems weapon tokens from Heroic Castle Nathria for Necrolord players. The vendors for the other difficulties—Mellisa Fate, Mortis Elfsen, and Odious Gwor—are located next to her. __NOTOC__
Tal-Galan is an attendant located at various locations in Korthia.

Taking the Tremaculum is awarded to players who complete all ten quests during the Venthyr Assault. By virtue of four quests being available each week, this will take three assaults (six weeks) at minimum.
Tainted Centurion Core drops from the following in Bastion: *Anima Channeler *Automated Defender *Dark Sentinel *Enforcer Asorius *Ravening Guardian
Tal-Xuhl is a dead attendant located outside the Vault of Secrets in southern Korthia. Protector Kah-Rev is looking for Tal-Xuhl and two Keepers of Korthia, part of the Chains of Domination campaign.

Tal-Yor is an attendant located outside the Vault of Secrets in southern Korthia. Protector Kah-Rev is looking for Tal-Yor and two other attendants in Keepers of Korthia, part of the Chains of Domination campaign.

Tal-Rahl is an attendant located outside the Vault of Secrets in southern Korthia. Protector Kah-Rev is looking for Tal-Rahl and two other attendants in Keepers of Korthia, part of the Chains of Domination campaign.
Tainted Bloodpetals are Nightmare-corrupted lashers located in the reflection of Un'Goro Crater within the Emerald Nightmare.
Tailthrasher Waistband is a world drop and is looted from Dusty Lockbox.

Tale of the Tangle is a message posted on a tree at the Oaken Assembly in Ardenweald. It's the starting point of a puzzle that requires you to take a specific path through the Mistveil Tangle in order to obtain the Shimmermist Runner mount.
The Talbuk Tagger is provided as an objective for Creatures of the Eco-Domes.
Taladorantula Terrorfang drops from Taladorantula at Deathweb Hollow in Talador.
Tales of the Exile is an exploration achievement earned by Read the volumes of "Firim in Exile" found in Zereth Mortis.
Tainted Avians were proto avians located in Provis Esper in Zereth Mortis.
Tal'gurub Villagers are dead jungle trolls located in Tal'gurub in Zuldazar. They were slain by the Jambani.
Tal'gurub Headhunters are dead jungle trolls located in Tal'gurub in Zuldazar. They were slain by the Jambani, while survivors were taken as mindslaves.
Tainted Walkers are skeletons located at the Soul Ruin on the Broken Shore.
The Tainted Corruptor's Vambraces drop from Occularus in Val and Inquisitor Meto in Naigtal.
Talendara is a blue dragonspawn located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
__NOTOC__ Tal'jin is a jungle troll innkeeper located at Theron's Watch in the Azure Span.
Taking From Nature is a reputation achievement earned by unlocking 5 different fishing nets in Tuskarr fishing Holes.
__NOTOC__ Taivan is a gigantic and very friendly red gold bakar located in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He can be summoned by Taivan's Trumpet.
Taivan's Trumpet is a quest reward from Taivan's Purpose from Healer Selbekh in Maruukai on the Ohn'ahran Plains. Using it summons Taivan.
Tale-Teller Talpi is a niffen located in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern. He is sitting with Apprentice Dae and a crowd of Studious Niffen and a single Terrified Niffen.

The term talk means communicating with a non-player character (NPC) by right-clicking on them. Player characters communicate with each other through chat. Additional notes: * You should see a speech bubble icon () with a small triangle (silver or gold ) when you move your pointer over the creature. * If your character is too far away to talk, the small triangle will be silver. *: out of range * If your character is close enough to talk, the small triangle will be gold. *: in range to talk Note: You can speak to NPCs in druid forms as of Patch 2.0.3.

Talon Gate is the west gate into Orgrimmar. During the Darkspear Rebellion, the Kor'kron guarded the gate. Thrall and Varok Saurfang passed through the gate, stopped by the guards but allowed to enter by Nazgrim.

The Talon of Vultros drops from the rare spawn Vultros which can be found in Westfall. The older version of the dagger (see external links under Original column) may still be looted from Battered Junkbox.

__NOTOC__ Talisman of Binding Shard is a legendary item, notable for only ever dropping once. It was looted from Baron Geddon in Molten Core by Noktyn-Archimonde US of the guild Nurfed on March 23, 2005. The item is no longer obtainable; Blizzard removed it from the loot tables the same day Noktyn obtained it, but allowed Noktyn to keep theirs. According to Travis Day, Talisman of Binding Shard was used by Blizzard in a test version of the Thunderfury quest line. The quest was removed and was not publicly released, but Blizzard forgot to remove the item from the loot table.
The Talon of Furious Concentration is held in the off hand for offensive casters.
Tally Berryfizz is a gnome alchemy trainer located in the shop Berryfizz's Potions and Mixed Drinks in Tinker Town within Ironforge.
Talo Thornhoof is a tauren quest giver located at Camp Ataya in Feralas.

Talin Keeneye is a dwarf quest giver located in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. Sten Stoutarm had adventurers forward mail to him, and Talin in turn forwarded mail to another dwarf; one Grelin Whitebeard, to the southeast. Talin was also an avid hunter, and enjoyed hunting boars the most. There had been an influx to the local population of boars, and their aggressiveness had made Talin's favourite passtime dangerous. Talin enlisted enterprising adventurers to thin the Small Crag Boar population with some hunting of their own so that he could return to hunting at a "leisurely" pace.
The Talon Den is a barrow den on Stonetalon Peak inhabited by Mirkfallon Dryads, night elves Cenarion Caretakers, and Mirkfallon Keepers.

Tammis Foxton was Aedelas Blackmoore's personal servant. He was with Aedelas when they both discovered Thrall, and was promoted when he forced his wife Clannia to become the little baby orc's wet nurse. He was also Taretha and Faralyn's father. Since they raised Thrall, the Foxton family received a better position. He survived the fall of Durnholde as Thrall ordered Grom to have Tari's necklace delivered to her parents. His subsequent fate is unknown.
The Talisman of Protection drops off High Priestess Mar'li in Zul'Gurub in Stranglethorn Vale.
Tamed Hyena are hyenas located in Razorfen Kraul. They cannot be tamed by a hunter.

Tallow is a Forsaken quest giver located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He came to the center of the town to see the arrival of Orkus and Kasha. He was present during the Legion Invasions, slashing his enemies.

Talon King Ikiss (pronounced Eye-kiss), the boss of Sethekk Halls in Auchindoun, is one of the leaders of the Sethekk, along with Darkweaver Syth. Together, they led the exodus of the Sethekk from Skettis to the ruins of Auchindoun. Although a charismatic leader at the beginning, Ikiss has since descended into madness. He now openly proclaims that he is Terokk reborn and expects the arakkoa to bow down to him as their ruler.

Tallstalk Mushroom is a reputation reward; you must be friendly with Sporeggar to purchase it for from in Zangarmarsh.
Talisman of the Naga Lord dropped from Lord Sakrasis in Stranglethorn Vale prior to Cataclysm.
Talvash's Enhancing Necklace is a quest reward from Restoring the Necklace (2).
Talvash's Gold RIng is a ring. It is made and later improved by Talvash del Kissel.

Taming the Beast is the first pet taming quest in the chain of three for dwarf hunters. It has the hunter capture a Large Crag Boar for use as a pet.

Talonpriest Ishaal is an arakkoa ghost found in Terokkar Forest. Talonpriest Ishaal can only be seen and engaged in combat while under the effects of an Elixir of Shadows, obtainable from the quest World of Shadows (quest) and the repeatable quest More Shadow Dust. Killing Ishaal gives 10 Sha'tari Skyguard reputation.
__NOTOC__ Talonsworn Forest-Ragers are Draenor ancients located in Skettis deep in the Terokkar Forest.
Talvash's Phial of Scrying is provided for Back to Uldaman. It is aalso a quest reward from Replacement Phial.
__NOTOC__ Talonpriest Skizzik can be found in Terokkar Forest. Killing this arakkoa will result in +10 reputation with the Sha'tari Skyguard.

Taming the Beast is the night elf version of the level 10 hunter quest chain in which hunters learn to tame their first pet. New hunters may want to check out the Pet (Hunter) for information about how to tame, feed, and choose a pet.
Talisman of Corruption is found inside Xabraxxis' Demon Bag. The bag drops from Xabraxxis in Darkshore when he is killed.
Talonguard Greaves are a world drop from almost any mob in Outland.

__NOTOC__ Talonpriest Zellek can be found at Skettis in Terokkar Forest in the west part of the Blackwind Lake at the highest top of the treehouse village. He can only be fought under the effects of Elixir of Shadows.

Tallonkai's Dresser can be found in Starbreeze Village of Teldrassil.
Tamed Proto-Whelps are proto-dragons found at the Ember Clutch in the Howling Fjord.
Talonshrike is an eagle who spawns in the Howling Fjord during Eyes of the Eagle (quest).

The Talisman of Arathor is an Alliance faction quality PvP reward trinket that can be obtained through Arathi Basin. It is available at various levels, and can periodically be used to absorb a certain amount of physical damage. Along with the and the / , it is one of the few trinkets available to low level Alliance players.
The Talisman of Scourge Command drops from Prince Taldaram in Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom on normal mode.

Tamara Wobblesprocket is a level 77 human quest giver found at River's Heart in Sholazar Basin. She is the wife of Marvin Wobblesprocket, whom she accompanied on the expedition at Hemet Nesingwary's behest. Because Marvin is a gnome, this makes Tamara one of the only humans known to have married outside of their race (the other being Rhonin).
Talonshrike's Egg can be found in a nest among other eggs at the bottom of a waterfall in Howling Fjord.
__NOTOC__ Talismanic Textiles is a tailoring shop found in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran the proprietor is Charles Worth.
Talu Frosthoof is a taunka bowyer located at Camp Winterhoof in the Howling Fjord.
This item is a quest reward from * Northern Hospitality * Eyes Above
Tamed Shoveltusks are shoveltusks located on Cauldros Isle in the Howling Fjord. They have been tamed by the wolvar of the Howling tribe.

Talking Murloc Plush Toy is an officially licensed product made by J!NX that stands about a 9 inches (23 cm) tall. It makes electronicized version of the murloc call (but much lower quality) when its lower jaw is squeezed. From the J!NX product description: :Stalking through your nightmares, the fearsome Murloc unleashes its bone-chilling battle cry: RWLRWLRWLRWL! Fortunately for you, the intrepid J!NX Crew has hunted across Azeroth and pacified the once-feral creatures. They are now plush and fuzzy, and will coo you off to sleep with an oddly familiar lullaby. Cuddle up with your very own Murloc today!
Talla is one of the challenges in the combat ring of Valhalas in Icecrown.
Taley is a Forsaken poison and reagent vendor located in the Tenebrous Cavern in the Abyssal Depths.
Tamed Ravagers protect Mag'har Post alongside their Mag'har masters.
Talonbranch Guardians are the guards of Talonbranch Glade in Felwood. They can be found spread throughout the post, taking guard stations. Several of them can be seen patrolling about.
First tallstrider mounts became available as mounts near the end of Cataclysm. These mounts can only currently be obtained through world events and the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game.
One must have a minimum of 75 Engineering skill to be eligible for this quest.
Taliesin Jaffe is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
The Tame Steppebeast is a mushan located at Longying Outpost in Townlong Steppes. It pulls a Shado-Pan Caravan cart during In Search of Suna.
Tamed Serpents are cloud serpents located in the Jade Forest.

Tallmug's Camp is a tiny grummle camp on the south face of Kota Peak just to the north of Firebough Nook in the southwest corner of Kun-Lai Summit. The path to the basecamp begins next to the Serpent's Spine north of the nook. From the camp, the path, marked with red flags, leads up to the southern yeti cave and the peak proper.
Tamed Crawlers are crabs from Darkshore and Shimmering Expanse. They are kept by Greymist Refugees and Kvaldir Deepwalkers as pets. They are also flagged as a "pet", rendering them untamable.
The Talking Skull guides you through Scholomance. It wants to see the corruption of the Scourge erased from its halls.
Taming Outland is an achievement for defeating all of the Pet Tamers in Outland in Pet Battles. It is part of the Taming Azeroth meta-achievement.
Taming Kalimdor is an achievement for defeating all of the Pet Tamers in Kalimdor in Pet Battles. It is part of the Taming Azeroth meta-achievement.
Taming Azeroth is an achievement for defeating all of the Pet Tamers up to Pandaria.
Taming Northrend is an achievement for defeating all of the Pet Tamers in Northrend in Pet Battles. It is part of the Taming Azeroth meta-achievement.

Taming Eastern Kingdoms is an achievement for defeating all of the Pet Tamers in Eastern Kingdoms in Pet Battles. It is part of the Taming Azeroth meta-achievement.
Taming Pandaria is an achievement for defeating all of the Pet Tamers in Pandaria in Pet Battles. It is part of the Taming Azeroth meta-achievement.

Tamer is a title awarded when you complete the Pet Battle meta-achievement Taming Azeroth, earned by defeating every Pet tamer NPC to be found in Kalimdor, the Eastern Kingdoms, Outland, Northrend and Pandaria. The title appears before your character's name: :Tamer
Tamed Bladetalons are raptors ridden by a Zandalari Beastlords in the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.
The Tamed Pterrorwing is ridden by Ku'lai the Skyclaw. See Ku'lai's article for tactics.
The Talisman of True Treasure Tracking is a vanity item that originally had no point, but was eventually updated to lead adventurers on the path of The Hivemind (mount).
Talisman of Angry Spirits drops from the Council of Elders in the Throne of Thunder.
Talut is a kodo located at the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
The Tallgrass Guerilla's Belt is created using Latent Kor'kron Belt with a Radical Mojo.
Taming the Tempest is one of seven random weekly raid quests offered in Normal/Heroic Throne of Thunder.

__NOTOC__ Talrendis Ambassadors are night elf magi intent on convincing the furbolg to join the Alliance in Azshara, though Haggrum Bloodfist and Andorel Sunsworn of the Horde apparently manage to disrupt such negotiations. They can be found in the southwest corner of the Blackmaw Hold lands, above ground.
Talonbreaker is found at in a den atop Dreadtalon Peak in south-central Spires of Arak.
Talon Guard Kurekk is an arakkoa. He can be recruited into garrison and become bodyguard. He can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.
Talonpriest Mask is a common arakkoa archaeology artifact, created from 50 Arakkoa Archaeology Fragment. One Arakkoa Cipher may be used to solve this artifact.

Tall Buck is a large talbuk stallion who dwells in a small swamp at the Lonely Falls in . His is slightly larger than a regular breezestrider talbuk, which gives him his name, and he is the lord of the herd, true to his title. Rangari Laara and Stalker Ogka want his bushy tail.
Talisman of the Fomor drops from Kromog in Blackrock Foundry.
The Talon Guard Staff is a quest reward from When All Is Aligned.

Talon Guard Varook is an arakkoa found in the Town Hall in Stormshield.
